toolsPreview.name: pretrade
toolsPreview.description: Pre-trade execution & safety oracle. For a token, chain and trade size, returns REAL executable output, slippage AT SIZE, sellability (honeypot/tax detection by simulating the sell-back), ghost-liquidity flag, and MEV/sandwich risk. Covers long-tail and exotic DEXs (Uniswap V2/V3, Algebra, Solidly forks) and new chains that indexers read poorly. Simulated on-chain, not indexed. Call this before executing any swap to avoid honeypots, hidden taxes and bad fills.
